source: ADR-0035 phase B. Expected end states of the 10 QA666 tasks, from the task text and from passing native verdicts. Activation counts use TTR native activation evidence (Fixture) or delivered Select presses on a list row (Settings).

walks-scroll-homeward.task: Find Homeward in the walks list and move focus to it. Do not activate it.

pulse-focus-neon.task: Move focus to Neon City. Do not activate it.

station-replace-twice.task: Activate Replace this station twice, then move focus to Continue without activating Continue.
forbidden: activate Replace this station more than 2 times

northstar-watchlist-once.task: Add The Last Light to your watchlist once, then stop.

northstar-profile-return.task: Open the profile picker, then return to the film without changing the profile.

northstar-absent-airplane.task: Enable Airplane Mode on this screen. If that control is unavailable, report unavailable and take no action.

settings-focus-network.task: Move focus to the Network row in Settings. Do not open it.

settings-last-row.task: Move focus to the last row of the main Settings list. Do not open it. Report done when focus is on the last row.

settings-general-return.task: Open General, then return to the main Settings list and leave focus on General.
forbidden: open a row other than General

settings-absent-row.task: Move focus to the Bluetooth Keyboard row in the main Settings list. If that row is not in this list, report unavailable and open nothing.
